req.title: Player update persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall write updates to the players table so subsequent GET calls reflect the modification.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/{squadNumber} must persist updates to the DB so subsequent GET calls reflect the change. The source reveals a deliberate bug: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit (the try block returns False instead of True), causing the route to raise HTTP 500. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid full update returns 204 and GET reflects new data; (2) negative NEG — squad_number mismatch in body vs path returns 400; (3) negative NEG — non-existent squad number returns 404; (4) STC — state transition: create then update then GET verifies persistence; (5) BVA — boundary squad numbers (squad 1 and squad 26, the edges of the seeded data); (6) DT — body squad_number matches path but other fields change, verifying all fields are updated. The known bug (always returns False -> 500) means positive tests will catch the mutation where False is changed to True (fixing the bug counts as a mutation kill). All tests use exact status code assertions and exact field value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_put_valid_player_returns_204():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "KabirUpdated",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "ReddyUpdated",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Left Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "LW",
        "team": "Arsenal",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b""

test_put_valid_player_returns_204()

tests.name: test_put_persists_to_db_get_reflects_update
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=5 exists (Vivaan Nair, Central Midfield)
FastAPI TestClient is available
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/5 with updated first_name, last_name, position
Assert GET response reflects the updated values
trace: R-PLAYER-020: subsequent GET calls reflect the modification
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_put_persists_to_db_get_reflects_update():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "VivaanNew",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "NairNew",
        "dateOfBirth": "1905-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 5,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "AM",
        "team": "Independiente",
        "league": "Liga Profesional",
        "starting11": False
    }
    put_r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/5", json=payload)
    assert put_r.status_code == 204
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/5")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "VivaanNew"
    assert body["lastName"] == "NairNew"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 5

test_put_persists_to_db_get_reflects_update()
